chapters.title: Unit 1. Where are you from? Lesson 1. What country are you from?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 6. 1) Как зовут ребят; 2) откуда они; 3) какая Англия и какие США.
steps: 1) Ann and Dave.
2) Ann is from England. Dave is from the USA.
3) England is small and beautiful. The USA is a very big country.
problems.answer: Ann — England, small and beautiful; Dave — the USA, a very big country

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 7. Прочитай диалог и найди ответы Дэна на вопросы Дейва.
steps: What's your name? — I'm Dan. What country are you from? — I'm from Scotland. What is your country like? — Scotland is a beautiful country. We've got a monster!
problems.answer: Dan, from Scotland; Scotland is beautiful, it has got a monster

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 7. Вставь am / is / are.
steps: am, is, is, are.
problems.answer: am, is, is, are

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 4, с. 7. Расскажи о своей стране по плану.
steps: My name is Anna. I'm from Russia. Russia is a big country. We've got the Kremlin. It is in Moscow.
problems.answer: My name is … I'm from Russia. Russia is a big country. We've got …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 5, с. 7. AB 2.1) Вставь am/is/are, have got/has got; AB 2.2) расскажи о любимом герое; Reader 1.1–1.2) где живёт герой и в каком доме.
steps: AB 2.1: am, have got, are, am, have got, is, are, is.
AB 2.2: I like Toto. He is a little black dog.
Reader 1.1: New York City. 1.2: We live in a little house near a park in New York.
problems.answer: am, have got, are, am, have got, is, are, is; Toto; New York, a little house

chapters.title: Unit 1. Where are you from? Lesson 2. What are the colours of your city?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 8. 1) Что на картинках; 2) о чём говорит девочка; 3) прочитай текст о городе Энн.
steps: 1) There is a zoo, a cave, a stadium and mountains. There is a river, a lake, a bridge, a forest and a station.
2) a river, a bridge, a lake, a stadium.
3) Ann lives in London. It's a big beautiful city with a nice river and a long bridge.
problems.answer: zoo, cave, stadium, mountains, river, lake, bridge, forest, station; London — river, bridge

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 9. Расскажи, что есть в твоём городе.
steps: There is a river, a bridge, a stadium, a station and a zoo in my city.
problems.answer: There is a … in my city.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 3, с. 9. 1) О чём спрашивают Дэна; 2) что Дэн рассказывает о городе.
steps: 1) What city are you from? — I live in Edinburgh. What is your city like? — It's big and beautiful. Is there a zoo in your city? — Yes, there is.
2) Dan lives in Edinburgh. It's a big city with many wonderful places. There is a big zoo with funny animals. There are mountains in his region.
problems.answer: Edinburgh — big and beautiful, a zoo, mountains

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 4, с. 10. 1) Вопросы Дейву о городе; 2) что есть в его городе (стихотворение); 3) опиши свой город по образцу.
steps: 1) What city are you from? Is it a big city? What is your city like? Is there a stadium / a river in your city? Do you like your city?
2) a house (white), a bridge (black), a park (green), a school (brown).
3) My house is brown. The river is blue. The park is green. The school is yellow and white.
problems.answer: вопросы с what / is there; house, bridge, park, school; My … is (colour).

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 5, с. 10. Составь рассказ о своём городе.
steps: I live in Moscow. It is a big and beautiful city. There are many wonderful places there. There is a stadium near my house. It is big and new. I go running there with my friends. There are parks and a zoo in my city.
problems.answer: I live in … It is … There is / are …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 6, с. 10. AB 2) Заполни пропуски формами to be и have got, напиши о герое; Reader 3.1–3.2) загадка.
steps: AB 2: am, have got, are, am, have got, is, are, is. Dorothy is very happy. She has got a dear friend. He is a little black dog. They are from Kansas. It is in the USA.
Reader 3.1: heart — ядро. 3.2: a walnut — грецкий орех.
problems.answer: am, have got, are, am, have got, is, are, is; Dorothy and Toto from Kansas; a walnut

chapters.title: Unit 1. Where are you from? Lesson 3. What do you like about your country?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 11. 1) Что нравится ребятам; 2) чтение буквы A.
steps: 1) They like the lake, the flag, the cave, candy, the stadium, summer camps, the station.
2) /eɪ/: lake, flag, cave, station. /æ/: candy, stadium, summer camps.
problems.answer: /eɪ/ lake, cave, station; /æ/ candy, camp

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 12. 1) Прочитай новые слова; 2) распредели животных по чтению буквы A.
steps: 1) lake — озеро, flag — флаг, tale — сказка, capital — столица, game — игра, champion — чемпион, favourite place — любимое место.
2) /eɪ/: alligator, whale, snake, raven, ladybird. /æ/: dragonfly, panda, parrot, rat, crab, panther, rabbit, hamster.
problems.answer: /eɪ/ whale, snake, raven; /æ/ panda, parrot, rat, crab, rabbit, hamster

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 13. Игра «Алфавитная гонка».
steps: Команды получают карточки со словами и раскладывают их в алфавитном порядке на скорость.
problems.answer: Игра на алфавит.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 13. 1) Прочитай тексты об известных местах; 2) почему они нравятся детям.
steps: The Lake District is a fantastic place! Baseball is his favourite game. His summer camp is a fantastic place!
problems.answer: the Lake District — fantastic; baseball — favourite game; summer camp — fantastic

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 13. AB 2) Распредели растения по чтению буквы A; Reader 4.1–4.3) новые слова и что любит девочка.
steps: AB 2: /eɪ/: potato, apricot, grapefruit, grapes. /æ/: apple, mango, carrot, cabbage, tangerine.
Reader 4.1: ham sandwich — бутерброд с ветчиной, potato chips — чипсы, apricot cake — абрикосовый пирог. 4.2: She likes pancakes with apple jam and marmalade. 4.3: She likes watching pancake races.
problems.answer: /eɪ/ potato, apricot, grapes; /æ/ apple, mango, carrot; pancakes, pancake races

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, Reading lesson, с. 13. Reader 5.1–5.5 (Страна Оз), 6.1–6.2 (друзья Алисы).
steps: 5.1: the witches of the Land of Oz — ведьмы Страны Оз; the ruler of the Emerald City — правитель Изумрудного города. 5.2: The Land of Oz is a big and beautiful country. 5.3: wall, gate, houses, palace. 5.4: Ozma. 5.5: /eɪ/ — name, gate; /æ/ — capital, palace, can, land, animal, happy.
6.1: Pig Baby, Cheshire Cat, Mad Hatter, White Rabbit, Caterpillar. 6.2: It's the Mouse — mice don't like cats and dogs. to hate — ненавидеть, sad — грустный.
problems.answer: Ozma; wall, gate, houses, palace; the Mouse; hate, sad

chapters.title: Unit 1. Where are you from? Lesson 4. We like playing games

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 14. 1) Чем любит заниматься Энн; 2) Том и Тед; 3) дети на картинках; 4) считалки Дэна.
steps: 1) Ann likes reading books.
2) Tom and Ted like playing games.
3) Steve likes roller-skating. Mark and Dave like playing tag. Mark likes going on rides. Ada likes playing badminton. Pat and Nancy like singing songs. Sam likes skateboarding.
4) One potato, two potatoes, three potatoes, four…
problems.answer: … likes / like …ing

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 16. Напиши, чем любят заниматься герои сказок.
steps: Hi! I'm George. I like playing ping-pong. My mother likes playing the piano. Our cat Snowy likes sleeping. My father likes reading.
problems.answer: I like playing…; … likes playing / reading / sleeping

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 16. Сыграй в игру в классе.
steps: I like playing computer games. I do not like reading books. Do you like singing songs?
problems.answer: I like … I don't like … Do you like …?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 16. Составь и разыграй диалог.
steps: A: Do you like reading tales? B: Yes, I do. A: What's your favourite tale? B: My favourite tale is «The Little Mermaid» by H. C. Andersen.
problems.answer: Do you like …? What's your favourite …?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 5, с. 16. Расскажи, что любишь и не любишь делать.
steps: I like playing sports. My favourite sport is basketball. But I don't like playing hockey.
problems.answer: I like … My favourite … is … But I don't like …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 6, с. 16. All about me 1) любимые занятия; Reader 8) соотнеси картинки с занятиями.
steps: All about me: I like playing sports — basketball. I like reading tales — «The Little Mermaid». I like watching TV.
Reader 8: A — 3 (picnics), B — 6 (reading tales under a tree), C — 1 (climbing mountains).
problems.answer: любимые занятия; A3, B6, C1

chapters.title: Unit 1. Where are you from? Lesson 5. I like my country

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 17. 1) Что на картинке; 2) порядок рассказа Кейт; 3) ответь на вопросы; 4–5) хотел бы ты поехать в Уэльс / в какую часть Великобритании.
steps: 1) I can see sheep, mountains, trees and a map.
2) about her country — about her city — about her favourite place.
3) Kate is from Wales. She lives in Cardiff. Her favourite place is a wonderful park.
4–5) Yes, I'd like to go to Wales. It is a small country with beautiful forests, rivers, mountains and lakes.
problems.answer: Wales, Cardiff, a park; I'd like to go to Wales

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 18. 1) Прослушай песню «This land is your land»; 2) какие песни о стране ты любишь петь.
steps: 1) Смысл: эта земля — твоя и моя, от Калифорнии до Нью-Йорка.
2) I like singing «Подмосковные вечера» and «Город, которого нет».
problems.answer: I like singing …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 3, с. 18. Составь вопросы зарубежному другу о его стране и расскажи о своей.
steps: Where are you from? What is your country like? What city do you live in? Is there a river in your city? What is your favourite place?
I am from Russia. It is a big country with forests, rivers and lakes. I live in St Petersburg. It is a big beautiful city. There are many rivers and bridges.
problems.answer: вопросы: Where are you from? What is … like?; рассказ: I am from Russia…

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 4, с. 18. Сыграй в игру: составь предложения из слов.
steps: Let's count. I have got a family. What do you like? Is there a school? It is a beautiful country. What is your name? What is London like? This river is long. Where are you from?
problems.answer: 9 предложений из карточек

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 5, с. 18. Заполни пропуски в тексте «Моя страна».
steps: Russia; big; rivers, mountains and lakes; St Petersburg; a beautiful city; rivers and lakes; Udelny Park; to walk.
problems.answer: Russia, big, rivers / mountains / lakes, St Petersburg, beautiful, park, walk

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 5, упр. 6, с. 18. Проект «Мой регион».
steps: I am from Russia. My country is big. There are rivers, mountains and lakes. I live in St Petersburg. It is a beautiful city. In my region you can see rivers and lakes. My favourite place is Udelny Park. I like walking there.
problems.answer: I am from … I live in … My favourite place is …

chapters.title: Unit 2. Is your family big? Lesson 1. How old are you?

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 20. 1) Кто из родственников на картинках; 2) сколько лет Кёрку и родным; 3) игра «Цифры».
steps: 1) parents (father and mother), brother, sister, grandmother and grandfather.
2) Kirk is nine. His father is forty-one. His mother is forty. His brother Clive is eleven. His sister Helen is fifteen. His grandpa is sixty-five. His grandma is sixty-four.
problems.answer: Kirk 9, father 41, mother 40, Clive 11, Helen 15, grandpa 65, grandma 64

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 22. Напиши, сколько лет другу Кёрка и его родным.
steps: Will is ten. His father is forty-one. His mother is thirty-five. His grandpa is fifty-nine. His grandma is fifty-seven.
problems.answer: Will 10, father 41, mother 35, grandpa 59, grandma 57

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 22. 1) Прочитай диалог; 2) составь похожий.
steps: 1) How old are you? — I'm nine. My brother is nine too. We are twins. Have you got a brother? — Yes, I have. — How old is he? — He is twelve.
2) How old is your mother? — She is thirty-nine. How old is your father? — He is forty. How old is your brother? — He is fourteen. How old is your sister? — She is five.
problems.answer: How old is …? — He / she is …

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 4, с. 22. Посчитай, сколько объектов на картинке.
steps: There are thirteen boys. There are eight girls. There are twenty-one children. There are ten balls. There are three dogs.
problems.answer: 13 boys, 8 girls, 21 children, 10 balls, 3 dogs

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 5, с. 22. Прочитай, сколько живут животные.
steps: Ravens can live 70 years. Alligators — 55 years. Turtles — 70 years. Parrots — 63 years. Elephants — 60 years.
problems.answer: ravens 70, alligators 55, turtles 70, parrots 63

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 6, с. 22. Игры с числительными.
steps: Читаем по таблице чётные, нечётные числа, числа с -teen и -ty.
problems.answer: Игра: чётные, нечётные, -teen, -ty

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 7, с. 22. Посчитай животных на картинке.
steps: twenty-five ducks, eighteen hens, twelve crocodiles, fourteen parrots, eleven flamingoes, seventeen horses.
problems.answer: 25 ducks, 18 hens, 12 crocodiles, 14 parrots, 11 flamingoes, 17 horses

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 1, упр. 8, с. 22. All about me 3) о родственниках; Reader 2.1–2.2) ярмарка.
steps: All about me: I am nine. My mother is thirty-one. My father is thirty-three. My sister is five. My brother is three. My grandma is fifty-five. My grandpa is sixty.
Reader 2: All my friends are in the street — Teddy, Billy, Sam and Pete. There is a funny cook, thirty balloons, cakes and sweets. Читаем стихотворение с правильными числами по картинке.
problems.answer: возраст родных; стихотворение о ярмарке

chapters.title: Unit 2. Is your family big? Lesson  2. What do you like?

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 23. 1) Имена родственников Кёрка; 2–3) чтение букв I и Y; 4) прочитай текст.
steps: 1) Kylie, Liz and Linda.
2–3) I и Y в открытом слоге — /aɪ/ (Kylie, like), в закрытом — /ɪ/ (Liz, Linda); ir / yr — /ɜː/.
problems.answer: Kylie, Liz, Linda; /aɪ/ открытый слог, /ɪ/ закрытый

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 24. О чём Кёрк любит читать?
steps: Kirk likes reading books about birds.
problems.answer: books about birds

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 2, упр. 3, с. 24. Игра «Алфавитная гонка».
steps: Раскладываем карточки со словами в алфавитном порядке на скорость.
problems.answer: Игра на алфавит.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 2, упр. 4, с. 24. Чем любят заниматься Кёрк и родные, какие у них питомцы?
steps: Shirley has got a pink pig. Kirk has got a funny bird. Clive likes playing pirates.
problems.answer: Shirley — a pig; Kirk — a bird; Clive — playing pirates

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 2, упр. 5, с. 25. Reader 3.1) что Лиззи покупает; 3.2) распредели слова с буквой i по звукам.
steps: 3.1: She buys fish, a silk wig, thirteen little piglets, six white mice, nine pink kites and thirty-six birds. She forgot soft drinks.
3.2: /aɪ/ white, mice, nine, kites, like. /ɪ/ little, Liz, drink, milk, silly, fish, wig, pigs, six, pink. /ɜː/ thirteen, thirty, birds.
problems.answer: /aɪ/ white, mice, nine; /ɪ/ little, milk, fish, pink; /ɜː/ thirteen, thirty, birds

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 2, упр. 6, с. 25. AB 1.1–1.4: названия сказок, звуки i / y, пропущенные буквы, транскрипция.
steps: 1.1: Silly Spiders — Глупые пауки; Thirty-three Wise Rhinos — 33 мудрых носорога; A Tiny Girl — Крошечная девочка.
1.2: /aɪ/ spider, wise, tiny, kite, prize, sky. /ɪ/ silly, rhino, in, rich. /ɜː/ girl.
1.3: mice, fish, circus, pig, tiger, bird.
1.4: thirteen /ˈθɜːˈtiːn/, Minnie /ˈmɪnɪ/, stamp /stæmp/, lace /leɪs/, hide /haɪd/.
problems.answer: /aɪ/ spider, wise, sky; /ɪ/ silly, rich; /ɜː/ girl, circus, bird

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 2, упр. 7, с. 25. AB 2.1–2.2) сказки Уилла; Reader 4.1–4.2) цирк.
steps: AB 2.1: Five Fingers — о пяти пальцах; My Circus — о цирке; Funny Birds — о попугаях; A Kitten in Hyde Park — о котёнке. 2.2: /aɪ/ five, my, Hyde; /ɪ/ fingers, funny, kitten; /ɜː/ circus, birds.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 26. 1) Ответь на вопросы по тексту; 2–3) слова частоты и их место.
steps: 1) They go to school. Kirk rides a bicycle to school. Kirk's friends come to his place after school. They watch films and cartoons and play on the computer.
2–3) always, usually, often, sometimes — перед глаголом; every day — в конце предложения.
problems.answer: always / usually / often / sometimes перед глаголом; every day в конце

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 27. Прочитай, чем занимается Уилл, и скажи, что делаешь это так же часто.
steps: I go to school every day too. I often watch cartoons too. I often play computer games too. I always help my mother too. I watch TV every day too. I usually swim in the river too.
problems.answer: I … too (с наречиями частоты)

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 28. 1) Что и как часто делают Кёрк и родные; 2) что они делают вместе.
steps: 1) Kirk and Clive play games and watch cartoons every day. They go to school every day. Sometimes they watch TV and play football. They often roller-skate.
2) Kirk, Clive and Helen often play games together. Sometimes they roller-skate together. They watch cartoons together every day.
problems.answer: … every day / often / sometimes / always … together

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 28. Что нового о Клайве (по записи)?
steps: In summer Clive often swims in the river. Clive likes reading. He reads tales every day.
problems.answer: swims in the river in summer; reads tales every day

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 29. Расспроси друзей, как часто они это делают.
steps: Do you often swim in the river? — Yes, in summer I often swim. Do you listen to music every day? — Yes, I like music. Do you always help your mother? — Yes, I do.
problems.answer: Do you often / always …? — Yes, I do / No, I don't

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 3, упр. 6, с. 29. Скажи, что делает Царь и как часто (рабочая тетрадь).
steps: The Tsar and his friends sometimes play Pirates. The Tsar rides a horse every day. The Tsar always talks to his parrot. The Tsar sometimes fishes. The Tsar and the Tsarina always count the money.
problems.answer: sometimes play Pirates, rides a horse every day, always talks to his parrot

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 3, упр. 7, с. 29. Назови имя куклы из сказки.
steps: The doll's name is Suok («Три толстяка»).
problems.answer: Suok

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 3, упр. 8, с. 29. All about me 4) ежедневные занятия; Reader 6.1–6.3) собачка Матт.
steps: All about me: I listen to music every day. I often watch cartoons. I sometimes sing songs. I usually play computer games.

problems.answer: мои занятия; Mutt — stubborn, smart, funny; b, c, d, e

chapters.title: Unit 2. Is your family big? Lesson  4. What games do you play?

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 30. 1) Чем любят заниматься Кёрк и брат; 2) какие вопросы задаёт Тим; 3) правило.
steps: 1) They like playing computer games and football.
2) Тим задаёт специальные вопросы — они начинаются с вопросительных слов what, where, when, why, how often.
3) What is your favourite colour? Where are my socks? What is it?
problems.answer: computer games and football; специальные вопросы с what / where / why / how often

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 31. 1) Вопросы Кёрка и ответы Тима; 2) на какой вопрос нет ответа; 3) о чём ещё спрашивает Кёрк.
steps: 1) Where do you roller-skate? — Near our house. How often do you watch TV? — Every day. Why do you watch TV every day? — It's interesting! What games do you play? — Computer games.
2) What sports do you play? — Football.
3) Where…? How often…? Why…? What games…?
problems.answer: where, how often, why, what games; What sports do you play? — Football.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 32. О чём ты спросил бы семью Кёрка о развлечениях?
steps: What do you usually play? When does your family usually play games? How often does your family play games? Where do you usually watch TV? How often does your family paint?
problems.answer: What / When / How often / Where do (does) … usually …?

problems.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 32. Поиграй в игру: составь вопросы из карточек.
